errors.text_span: Всички секторни етикети са отбелязани вътре в съответните им секции.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sector labels ('да', 'не', 'не мога да преценя') are inside the slices. In fact, only the percentage values (64%, 25%, 11%) are inside the slices. The labels for the categories are in the legend at the top.
The description places the legend at the 'top right' ('горе вдясно'), but it is located at the top center of the chart.
